summary.headline: EPACK Q2 FY27 revenue more than doubled to INR439 crores (+106% YoY), with EBITDA margin at 1.62% after no PLI income accrued.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations rose 106% YoY to INR439 crores, with H1 revenue of INR1,325 crores (+51.3%), the company's highest-ever first half. EBITDA was INR7.1 crores (margin 1.62%) versus INR0.5 crores a year earlier, but the prior-year quarter included INR8 crores of PLI income, which was not accrued this year. Excluding PLI, the company says EBITDA improved by about INR14.6 crores YoY, and it cites a forex loss of about INR10 crores as a drag. Management said the Epavo JV stake (50%) is being transferred to Ram Ratna Group for INR15 crores, and two dormant subsidiaries are being wound up.

segments.name: Room air conditioners (RAC)
segments.commentary: Q2 RAC revenue about INR161 crores, up about 160% YoY on a weak base (INR61-odd crores); H1 RAC grew 58%. Prices are up about 15-20% YoY model-wise. Installed capacity about 2.3 million sets.

segments.name: Small and large domestic appliances (SDA+LDA)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue about INR168 crores, up 57% from INR107 crores; H1 SDA and LDA grew 62%. Non-RAC share of revenue was 63% in Q2, with washing machines and air fryers leading growth.

segments.name: Components
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue about INR47 crores, up 45% from INR32 crores; captive integration deepening in heat exchangers, copper tubing, PCB, cross flow fans and moulding parts.

segments.name: Hisense (via EMTPL, wholly owned subsidiary)
segments.commentary: Approximately INR90 crores of Hisense sales in H1 FY27; about 18,000 ACs sourced so far this year. Front-load washing machine pilot production through end-November 2026, mass production from December.

guidance_outlook: No explicit numerical guidance; management said it does not give forward-looking numbers.
Management expects the AC industry to grow 20-25% in FY27; H1 AC value grew about 58.4%, volume about 40-45% (estimate).
Management expects to outgrow the industry on share gains and new customers.

Margin recovery is expected from rolling back PLI discounts in phases, a richer product mix, and fixed-cost absorption; PLI is the last year for EPACK per management, with possible extension under discussion with the ministry.
Balance capex of about INR100 crores to be staggered over the next 6-12 months; no significant medium-term investment plans; no new capital raise planned.
capex_capacity: Capex plan of about INR470 crores announced about 18 months ago; INR370 crores actualised by end-September 2026.
Balance INR100 crores to be spent over the next 6-12 months to ramp washing machines and newer AC models.
Front-load washing machine for Hisense via EMTPL (Sri City): pilot by end-November 2026, commercial production from December; takes EMTPL into multiple product categories.
Dehradun and Bhiwadi plants reported significantly better utilisation; capacity utilisation was the challenge in prior quarters.
Pipeline for FY27 includes oil filter heaters, washing machines, air purifiers and other products under development; vacuum cleaners, tower fans and nutri blenders launched during the year.
demand_pricing: Industry: RAC primary sales in Jul-Sep 2026 were better than last year, which was hit by unseasonal rains and GST-transition destocking; channel inventory is comfortable. Management estimates trade inventory 40-50% lower than last year's 5.5-6 million units at end-Q2.
Pricing: RAC prices up 15-20% YoY model-wise to pass through commodity (copper, aluminium, plastics) and FX costs; pass-through is on quarter-to-quarter contracts with a lag.
Forex was the largest drag; the rupee's depreciation against USD and CNY hit payments, with about INR10 crores forex loss in the quarter.
Customer concentration: top 2 customers at 32% of revenue vs 72% in FY26; 72 customers across 19 categories.
Non-AC share of business rose to nearly 50% from 45% year-on-year; air coolers were softer this year.

qa_highlights.question: How much of Q2 RAC growth came from volume versus pricing?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a volume split; it said RAC revenue grew about 160% YoY, with model-wise price increases of 15-20%.

qa_highlights.question: Has the 15-20% price hike covered all cost escalation to date?
qa_highlights.answer: Largely yes, with an ongoing lag as escalations pass through in subsequent quarters, and most vendors have had increases passed on.

qa_highlights.question: Post-PLI margin outlook and need for further price hikes?
qa_highlights.answer: Margins to improve as PLI discounts given to brands are rolled back in phases and mix shifts to SDA and LDA; no numerical margin guidance given.

qa_highlights.question: Hisense sales figures?
qa_highlights.answer: Approximately INR90 crores in H1; about 18,000 ACs sourced this year to September.

qa_highlights.question: Debt, finance cost and working capital outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Gross debt about INR770-775 crores, similar to last year; total finance cost flat despite revenue doubling; debt/equity about 0.8x in the medium term.

qa_highlights.question: Is any margin pass-through still left and what is the utilisation outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Some lag remains, but no significant gap; utilisation to improve with Hisense, washing machines and new southern customers; no explicit earnings guidance.

risks_watch: Forex volatility (INR/USD and INR/CNY) and commodity price swings, with pass-through lagging by a quarter.
Loss of PLI income for the year and uncertainty over a possible extension; PLI discounts to brands are being rolled back.
Gross margin of 12.8% (ex-PLI) remains thin; Q2 is seasonally weak and EBITDA margin was 1.62%.
Hisense washing machine ramp from December 2026 and whether the 18,000 AC run-rate translates into sustained volume.
Utilisation of new capacity (balance INR100 crores capex) and the Epavo JV exit, with the INR15 crore consideration.
summary.management_tone: Confident on top-line growth and share gains, but cautious and sometimes evasive on margins: it attributes weakness to forex, commodity lag and PLI absence, and gives no numerical margin or earnings guidance. Management declined to split RAC volume and pricing or give forward volume numbers.
key_quotes: Reported profitability is being held back by depreciation and interest for new capacity, the lag in passing through commodity costs, the absence of PLI income and seasonality, not by any weakness in demand for competitiveness.

So forex fluctuation is something which is -- which cannot be passed on real time and the payment -- when the payments are made to the customer, the way rupee has been depreciating with regards to USD, especially with regards to CNY is an area of concern.
We see our exit from Epavo as more of maintaining capital discipline and not as a retreat.

growth.why: Management gives no explicit numerical guidance but expects the AC industry to grow 20-25% in FY27 and EPACK to outgrow it via share gains; the 20% revenue figure is the low end of that industry view, not company guidance, backed partly by Hisense washing machine ramp from December and INR370 cr of the INR470 cr capex already spent.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: EBITDA margin was 1.62% in Q2 FY27 with gross margin ex-PLI at 12.8%; management expects recovery from phased rollback of PLI discounts to brands, richer mix toward SDA/LDA (non-AC now 50% of business) and fixed-cost absorption, but gave no numerical margin guidance and PLI income of about INR8 crores in the prior-year quarter is gone.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Balance INR100 crores of the INR470 crores capex is to be staggered over the next 6-12 months to ramp washing machines and newer AC models, with INR370 crores already actualised; Hisense washing machine mass production at EMTPL starts December 2026.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Management expects the AC industry to grow 20-25% in FY27 and EPACK to outgrow it; H1 revenue grew 51.3% to INR1,325 crores, with SDA+LDA up 62% in H1 and Hisense run-rate of about 18,000 ACs so far this year, though no volume split was given.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management says no significant medium-term investment plans and no new capital raise; the INR100 crores balance is already committed and being staggered, with Dehradun and Bhiwadi utilisation improving, so a fresh capex announcement is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numerical guidance is given, but H1 revenue rose 51.3% and like-for-like EBITDA grew 77%, and the 20-25% industry growth view plus Hisense ramp could support a stronger outlook; management is cautious on margins, so any upgrade is more likely on top line than margin.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Forex loss of about INR10 crores in Q2 and INR/USD and INR/CNY depreciation hit payments, commodity pass-through lags by a quarter, gross margin ex-PLI is thin at 12.8%, and the PLI extension is uncertain after FY27.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Hisense front-load washing machine pilot by end-November 2026 with commercial production from December; pipeline includes oil filter heaters, air purifiers and other products under development, following vacuum cleaners, tower fans and nutri blenders launched this year.

rows.label: Hisense washing machine ramp at EMTPL (Sri City)
rows.why: Pilot production by end-November 2026 and mass production from December, extending EMTPL into multiple product categories after about INR90 crores of Hisense sales in H1 FY27.

rows.label: Phased rollback of PLI discounts to brands
rows.why: Management says PLI discounts given to brands are being rolled back in phases, which should lift margins, though PLI income itself is nil this year against about INR30 crores in H1 FY26 and PLI is the last year for EPACK.

rows.label: Epavo JV exit to Ram Ratna Group
rows.why: The 50% Epavo JV stake is being transferred for INR15 crores and two dormant subsidiaries are being wound up, a small one-off with no material effect on the operating run-rate.
